title: Reward Engine: Reward-Centric Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Tool Agents
title_zh: 面向开放式工具代理的奖励引擎：以奖励为中心的自我进化方法

paragraphs.en: Open-ended tool agents can complete the same objective through different tool paths, and their quality depends jointly on the interaction trace, environment state, and final artifacts, so such tasks rarely admit an executable ground-truth reward. The central challenge is therefore to construct a reward from existing experience that exposes the current policy’s failures while remaining stationary during optimization. We introduce Reward Engine, which, like a self-motivated student, first works out what success requires and then optimizes toward it. From the task and initial trajectories, it builds a RewardPack of testcases for required correctness and rubrics for graded quality, each executed as a check that returns a judgment with evidence. The frozen RewardPack then guides the agent to revise and select its outputs, and can also serve as a reward for reinforcement learning. On WorkBuddy Bench Office and Claw-Eval, the constructed reward largely agrees with the benchmark graders, not reversing their ordering on 82.3% and 80.5% of candidate pairs. Used to revise executions, it raises three-run consistency ( Pass 3 \mathrm{Pass}^{3} ) over Baseline from 45.0% to 54.0% and from 78.4% to 83.7%.
paragraphs.zh: 开放式工具智能体可以通过不同的工具路径完成同一目标，其质量共同取决于交互轨迹、环境状态和最终产物，因此这类任务很少有可执行的真值奖励。 因此，核心挑战是从已有经验中构建一个奖励，使其既能暴露当前策略的失败之处，又在优化过程中保持稳定。 我们提出 Reward Engine，它像一名自我激励的学生，先弄清成功需要什么，然后朝此目标优化。 它从任务和初始轨迹出发，构建一个 RewardPack，其中包含用于检验正确性的测试用例和用于分级质量的评分准则，每一项都作为一个检查执行并返回带证据的判定。 冻结的 RewardPack 随后指导智能体修订和选择其输出，并且还可以作为强化学习的奖励。 在 WorkBuddy Bench Office 和 Claw-Eval 上，构建的奖励与基准评分器大体一致，在 82.3% 和 80.5% 的候选对上没有颠倒它们的排序。 用于修订执行时，它将三次运行一致性（ Pass 3 \mathrm{Pass}^{3} ）相对 Baseline 从 45.0% 提升到 54.0%，从 78.4% 提升到 83.7%。

paragraphs.en: Tool agents are increasingly asked to do open-ended work, such as reconciling spreadsheets, drafting reports from mixed-format files, or triaging tickets [ Yao et al., 2025 ; Tencent Youtu Lab et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ] . Unlike verifiable tasks such as math with final answers or code with unit tests [ Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ] , whose rewards directly drive reinforcement learning [ Shao et al., 2024 ] , these tasks come with no reward: many solutions are acceptable, and quality depends on the trace, environment state, and delivered artifacts. Constructing the reward thus becomes the key, and harder, problem; without it, an agent can neither critique and select among its attempts nor train on them. Common proxies fall short: a weekly report whose completion rate reads 92% although the source rows give 78% passes a file-existence check and can pass a holistic model judge, whose verdicts depend on presentation and ordering [ Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ] . paragraphs.zh: 工具型智能体被越来越多地要求完成开放性的工作，例如核对电子表格、根据混合格式的文件起草报告，或对工单进行分类分流 [ Yao et al., 2025 ; Tencent Youtu Lab et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ] 。 与具有最终答案的数学题或带有单元测试的代码等可验证任务 [ Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ] 不同——这类任务的奖励可直接驱动强化学习 [ Shao et al., 2024 ] ——上述任务没有奖励：许多解法都可接受，而质量取决于轨迹、环境状态以及交付的产物。 因此，构造奖励成为关键的、也更困难的问题；没有奖励，智能体既无法评估并从其多次尝试中作出选择，也无法据此进行训练。 常见的替代方法都有不足：一份周报的完成率显示为 92%，而源数据行实际给出的是 78%，它却能通过文件存在性检查，甚至可能通过整体性模型裁判的评判，因为此类裁判的结论依赖于呈现方式与排列顺序 [ Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ] 。 就像一个面对未曾学过的任务的自驱型学生，智能体必须首先弄清哪些约束条件必须成立、哪里有发挥的空间（ 图 1 ），而由此得出的奖励必须满足三个要求：

paragraphs.en: Evidence-grounded: each criterion, whether a hard constraint (testcase) or graded quality (rubric), must be judged by recomputing it from the artifact, trace, and environment and returned with a receipt, such as “expected 78%, observed 92%: fail”. The receipt tells a critic what to fix and a selector why one candidate ranks higher, and it keeps a violated requirement apart from an unreadable file or missing evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 证据可溯源：每条评判标准，无论是硬性约束（测试用例）还是分级的质量项（评分细则），都必须通过从工件、轨迹和环境中重新计算来判定，并附带一份凭证，例如「期望 78%，实际观测 92%：不通过」。 这份凭证告诉评审者该修复什么，告诉选择者为什么某个候选方案排名更高，并且它能把「违反了某项需求」与「文件无法读取或证据缺失」区分开来。

sents.en: Evidence-grounded: each criterion, whether a hard constraint (testcase) or graded quality (rubric), must be judged by recomputing it from the artifact, trace, and environment and returned with a receipt, such as “expected 78%, observed 92%: fail”.

paragraphs.en: Tested before use: a drafted check can itself be wrong, for instance by reading the wrong column or accepting a near miss, so the reward must be tested against labeled counterexamples before the agent relies on it, and a repair must not break cases it already judged correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 使用前需测试：起草的检查本身可能是错的，例如读错了列或接受了近似错误（near miss），因此在智能体依赖该奖励之前，必须用标注的反例对其进行测试，且修复不得破坏其已正确判断的案例。

paragraphs.en: Stationary: the reward must stay fixed while the agent is revised or selected against it and change only between rounds; otherwise an apparent gain may come from a moved target rather than a better output.
paragraphs.zh: 平稳性：在针对奖励对智能体进行修改或筛选时，奖励必须保持固定，且仅在轮次之间变化；否则，表面的收益可能来自被移动的目标，而非更好的输出。

paragraphs.en: Existing evaluators and reward-construction methods meet these requirements only in part ( Table 5 in Appendix A ). Model judges, rubric judges, and trained verifiers [ Zheng et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Saad-Falcon et al., 2025 ; Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Cobbe et al., 2021 ] score outputs, but their judgments are not bound to re-runnable procedures, and at most partially record the evidence behind them [ Zhuge et al., 2025 ; Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ] . Reward-construction methods write executable reward code or tests [ Ma et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023 ] but keep no evidence receipts, so a violated requirement cannot be told apart from a broken check. Most importantly, none tests the reward for a task on labeled counterexamples before optimizing against it, or accepts a repair only if earlier agreement is preserved; the closest, EvoRubrics [ Ding et al., 2026 ] , adapts its rubrics adversarially but updates them at every training step, so the target moves while it is used. What is missing is a reward that is evidence-grounded, tested against counterexamples before use, and held fixed while the agent is optimized against it.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的评估器和奖励构建方法只能部分满足这些要求（附录 A 中的表 5）。 模型裁判、量规裁判和训练得到的验证器 [ Zheng et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Saad-Falcon et al., 2025 ; Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Cobbe et al., 2021 ] 会对输出进行打分，但它们的判断并不绑定于可重新运行的程序，而且至多只能部分记录其背后的证据 [ Zhuge et al., 2025 ; Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ] 。 奖励构建方法会编写可执行的奖励代码或测试 [ Ma et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023 ] ，但不保留证据凭据，因此无法区分是需求被违反还是检查本身出了问题。 最重要的是，没有一种方法在针对奖励进行优化之前，先用带标注的反例对该任务的奖励进行测试，或者只有在保持此前一致性的情况下才接受修复；最接近的 EvoRubrics [ Ding et al., 2026 ] 以对抗方式调整其量规，但在每个训练步骤都进行更新，因此目标在使用过程中不断变动。 所缺失的是一种有证据支撑、在使用前经过反例测试、并在智能体针对其进行优化时保持固定不变的奖励。

sents.en: We introduce Reward Engine ( Figure 2 ) to close this gap: it builds such a reward for each task and uses it to improve the agent’s deliverable.
sents.zh: 我们提出奖励引擎（Reward Engine）（图 2）来弥补这一空白：它为每个任务构建这样的奖励，并利用它来改进智能体的交付成果。

sents.en: Each round has three stages:
sents.zh: 每一轮包含三个阶段：

paragraphs.en: Build reward. From the task and a few initial trajectories, never hidden answers or benchmark scores, a Jury drafts the task’s obligations as testcases or graded rubrics, and a Builder binds each to an executable check that returns a judgment with an evidence receipt ( Sections 2 and 3.1 ). A quality-control loop tests the reward on labeled control, error, and boundary cases and accepts only repairs that lose no previously matched case; the result is frozen as a RewardPack ( Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 构建奖励。 基于任务和少量初始轨迹（从不使用隐藏答案或基准分数），一个评审团（Jury）将任务的义务起草为测试用例或评分细则（rubrics），而一个构建者（Builder）将每项义务绑定到一个可执行的检查上，该检查返回带有证据回执的判定（第 2 节和第 3.1 节）。 一个质量控制循环在带标签的对照、错误和边界用例上测试该奖励，并且只接受不丢失任何先前匹配用例的修复；其结果被冻结为奖励包（RewardPack）（第 3.2 节）。

sents.zh: 构建奖励。

sents.en: From the task and a few initial trajectories, never hidden answers or benchmark scores, a Jury drafts the task’s obligations as testcases or graded rubrics, and a Builder binds each to an executable check that returns a judgment with an evidence receipt ( Sections 2 and 3.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Execute by reward. A Critic turns failed criteria into revision feedback, and a Jury ranks the revision with the round’s other candidates; a candidate replaces the fresh task-only one only if it ranks strictly higher and fails no test the task-only candidate passes ( Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 以奖励驱动执行。 评论者（Critic）将未通过的标准转化为修改反馈，评审团（Jury）将修改后的候选结果与该轮的其他候选结果进行排序；只有当某个候选结果的排名严格更高，且未通过任何仅基于任务生成的候选结果所通过的测试时，它才会替换该仅基于任务生成的候选结果（见 3.3 节）。

Products, receipts, and defects found during use inform only the next RewardPack, so the reward never shifts while it is used; a meta loop across task families, which we do not evaluate, can further refine how rewards are built. paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are (1) An evidence-grounded RewardPack of testcases for required correctness and rubrics for graded quality, built from the task and initial trajectories, each criterion and rubric bound to an executable evidence check ( Sections 2 and 3.1 ). (3) Two-benchmark evidence on WorkBuddy Bench Office and Claw-Eval that the RewardPack largely agrees with the benchmark graders and raises the delivered output’s pass rate over Baseline ( Section 4 ).

paragraphs.en: A criterion c i c_{i} is a testcase (required correctness, z i ∈ { 𝗉𝖺𝗌𝗌 , 𝖿𝖺𝗂𝗅 } z_{i}\in\{\mathsf{pass},\mathsf{fail}\} ) or a rubric (graded quality, z i ∈ { 𝖿𝖺𝗂𝗅 , 𝗉𝖺𝗋𝗍𝗂𝖺𝗅 , 𝖿𝗎𝗅𝗅 } z_{i}\in\{\mathsf{fail},\mathsf{partial},\mathsf{full}\} against written anchors); z i = ⊥ z_{i}=\bot means no judgment, and several bound tests give a tuple ( Section B.2 ). A check κ i \kappa_{i} is a stored, re-runnable procedure, either code, such as recomputing a rate from source rows, or a model judgment over evidence it first locates, so it need not be deterministic. The receipt e i e_{i} references the inspected evidence and records the execution status, keeping apart an observed violation (a failing judgment), insufficient evidence ( ⊥ \bot , normal status), and a check that did not run ( ⊥ \bot , error status). A RewardPack stores one version R v R_{v} with the records needed to audit and re-run it ( Table 7 ).

paragraphs.en: Three Jury members draft obligations from the public task before seeing any artifact, then revisit them against the initial task-only runs ℬ \mathcal{B} , which show where the current policy falls short and where acceptable solutions differ. A reducer merges the drafts into criteria, each marked as a testcase or a rubric, keeping each criterion’s source, applicability, and fail/partial/full anchors; unresolved obligations stay visible. paragraphs.en: Each task is executed in sequential rounds. paragraphs.en: Reward Engine makes reward construction part of solving open-ended tool tasks. From public task requirements and execution experience, it builds evidence-grounded checks for required correctness and graded quality, tests them against counterexamples, and holds the resulting reward fixed while it guides revision and selection. Updates between rounds incorporate new evidence without changing the standard during use. On WorkBuddy Bench Office and Claw-Eval, this approach raises three-run consistency over Baseline and improves selection over uniform choice among the same candidates by 1.83 and 2.36 points, respectively, with 95% confidence intervals excluding zero. Mean delivery gains over Baseline are clearest on Claw-Eval. The constructed reward also does not reverse the benchmark graders’ ordering on over 80% of evaluated candidate pairs. These results support constructing and validating rewards as a practical route to improving tool-agent outputs at inference time. Applying the same reward interface to reinforcement learning is a direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励引擎将奖励构建纳入开放式工具任务的求解过程。 它依据公开的任务要求与执行经验，针对所需的正确性与分级质量构建基于证据的检查项，用反例对其进行测试，并在引导修订与选择期间保持所得奖励固定不变。 轮次之间的更新纳入新证据，但不改变使用期间的标准。 在 WorkBuddy Bench Office 与 Claw-Eval 上，该方法将三次运行的一致性提升至 Baseline 之上，并在相同候选中的均匀选择之上使选择结果分别提升 1.83 与 2.36 分，95% 置信区间均不含零。 相对于 Baseline 的平均交付增益在 Claw-Eval 上最为明显。 所构建的奖励在超过 80% 的被评估候选对上也不会逆转基准评分器的排序。 这些结果表明，构建并验证奖励是提升智能体输出在推理阶段表现的一条可行路径。 将同一奖励接口应用于强化学习是未来的研究方向。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial review executes the control, error, and boundary cases of Section 3.2 . Reference models label anonymized material against public task evidence, blind to the RewardPack, the attack rationale, and the predicted labels, and replay preserves case identities and material. Beyond Eq. 4 , the implementation accepts a candidate only if known reference labels are unchanged and fresh boundary cases around the repair are supported; otherwise the incumbent is kept. Structural review checks bindings but not semantics, so a rebuild without adversarial review leaves its semantic correction unverified. QC routes confirmed checker defects to Builder, missing or mis-stated obligations to Jury, and independently established artifact defects to actor feedback, and leaves uncertain attributions unresolved; infrastructure failures permit bounded remeasurement. A checker repair preserves the criteria and unrelated checks, and a criterion repair remeasures only the affected bindings. Defects found while a reward is in use are queued and never modify the active version. The BoundaryUpdate operation in Algorithm 1 keeps, rebuilds, or revises the reward at a round boundary under comparison and tie rules fixed by the caller, carrying forward the repair ledger. It records the resulting reward as the next version R v + 1 R_{v+1} ; retaining the incumbent leaves the reward contents unchanged. These boundary transitions follow the caller’s rules rather than Eq. 4 . After QC, the latest version is frozen for the execution segment.

paragraphs.en: WorkBuddy Bench Office is the Office subset of a role-based benchmark whose other subsets cover Code, Web, and Security [ Tencent Youtu Lab et al., 2026 ] . We use all 50 tasks of the version-1.0 Office subset with equal weight. They involve spreadsheets, CSV, PDF, and word-processing documents (24 data/file operations, 17 document operations, and nine workspace-automation tasks), and their difficulty lies in data relationships, document structure, state, and supporting evidence rather than file size. Agents run in a sandboxed Docker workspace through Harbor. The CompositeVerifier combines deterministic checks on the submitted artifacts with a model judge over extracted evidence through a task-specific weighted sum; across our 150 final receipts, the deterministic weight ranges from 0.70 to 0.95. A run passes at 80 (inclusive). These external graders are distinct from the internal RewardPack measurements. Among 450 round-candidate records, the only invalid score is the initial-round task-only score on analyst-forecast-extract-L3-018 , archived as 72.8 with an invalid-scoring flag; we count it as zero and retain the raw value and flag. Selection returned the revision in that round, so it is unaffected.
paragraphs.zh: WorkBuddy Bench Office 是一个基于角色的基准测试中 Office 子集，该基准测试的其他子集涵盖代码、Web 和安全 [ Tencent Youtu Lab et al., 2026 ]。 我们使用 1.0 版 Office 子集的全部 50 个任务，且权重相等。 这些任务涉及电子表格、CSV、PDF 和文字处理文档（24 个数据/文件操作任务、17 个文档操作任务和 9 个工作区自动化任务），其难度在于数据关系、文档结构、状态和支持证据，而非文件大小。 智能体通过 Harbor 在沙箱化的 Docker 工作区中运行。 CompositeVerifier 将对提交产物的确定性检查与模型裁判对提取证据的评判结合起来，通过任务特定的加权和进行；在我们最终收到的 150 份回执中，确定性权重范围为 0.70 至 0.95。 运行结果达到 80 分（含）即为通过。 这些外部评分者有别于内部的 RewardPack 度量。 在 450 条轮次候选记录中，唯一无效的分数是 analyst-forecast-extract-L3-018 的首轮仅任务分数，归档值为 72.8 并带有无效评分标志；我们将其计为零，同时保留原始数值和标志。 该轮的选拔结果返回了该修订版本，因此不受影响。

paragraphs.en: Claw-Eval evaluates autonomous agents on tasks with executable environments and human-checked rubrics [ Ye et al., 2026 , Claw-Eval Contributors, 2026 ] . It contains 300 tasks and 2,159 rubrics across nine categories (161 general, 101 multimodal, and 38 multi-turn tasks), provides sandboxed services, records trajectories, and distinguishes completion, safety, and robustness; its leaderboard uses Pass 3 \mathrm{Pass}^{3} over three independent trials. We use 104 frozen task versions from 68 scenarios, including 36 bilingual pairs, scored on the continuous 0–100 native scale with a custom model judge; a run passes at 75 (inclusive). Each task version is evaluated over three sequential rounds of task-only, revision, and hypothesis-guided candidates, yielding 936 graded round candidates. Baseline repetition and aggregation are defined in Section D.2 . Our empirical three-run success metrics follow the aggregation in Sections D.2 and D.4 ; the sequential rounds are dependent, unlike the leaderboard’s independent-trial protocol.
paragraphs.zh: Claw-Eval 在具有可执行环境和人工核查评分标准的任务上评估自主智能体 [ Ye et al., 2026, Claw-Eval Contributors, 2026 ]。 它包含九个类别下的 300 个任务和 2,159 条评分标准（161 个通用任务、101 个多模态任务和 38 个多轮任务），提供沙箱服务、记录轨迹，并区分完成度、安全性与鲁棒性；其排行榜使用三次独立试验上的 Pass 3 \mathrm{Pass}^{3}。 我们使用来自 68 个场景的 104 个冻结任务版本（包括 36 对双语任务），采用自定义模型裁判在原生的 0–100 连续量表上评分；一次运行达到 75 分（含）即为通过。 每个任务版本在仅任务、修订和假设引导三轮顺序候选上进行评估，共产生 936 个经评分的轮次候选。 基线重复与聚合方式定义于 D.2 节。 我们的三次运行经验性成功率指标遵循 D.2 节和 D.4 节中的聚合方式；与排行榜的独立试验协议不同，这些顺序轮次是相互依赖的。

paragraphs.en: Each round launches a fresh task-only actor that receives only the public task and its attachments. The reward-guided revision additionally receives the current RewardPack and terminal Critic review: a model overview proposes up to three targeted checks per review, and each nonempty review permits one continuation in the same actor session followed by a recheck, with at most two revisions. Measurement, Critic calls, and continuations consume the execution budget. Revision stops early only when the current overview reports no gaps, nothing is deferred or carried over, and the selected checks and all blocking requirements pass; unselected checks remain unverified, so stopping does not certify full-pack coverage. When the budget is exhausted, the latest artifact is kept with its unresolved status. The hypothesis-guided candidate receives guidance from a Hypothesis module but neither the RewardPack nor the candidate pool. Before each round, the module reads the public task, Jury gaps, permitted knowledge, and same-task artifacts and checks from earlier rounds, and returns fallible guidance (a method, an optional target, the expected benefit, a verification plan, and clarification questions) or a keep decision, which reduces the candidate to task-only generation. On WorkBuddy Bench Office the archive records the guidance as applied on 41 tasks, a keep decision on two, and an unknown state on seven. Because the surrounding loop accumulates candidates, measurements, memory, and Jury decisions, “task-only” describes the actor’s prompt, not independence from the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 每一轮都会启动一个全新的仅任务智能体，它只接收公开任务及其附件。 奖励引导的修订版本还会接收当前的 RewardPack 和 Critic 的终局评审：模型概览在每次评审中最多提出三项针对性检查，且每次非空评审允许在同一智能体会话中续写一次并随后复检，最多修订两次。 测量、Critic 调用和续写都会消耗执行预算。 只有当当前概览报告没有缺口、没有遗留或延续事项，且所选检查和所有阻塞性要求都通过时，修订才会提前停止；未选中的检查仍未验证，因此停止并不意味着完整的全包覆盖。 当预算耗尽时，最新的产物将连同其未解决的状态一起保留。 假设引导的候选会接收来自 Hypothesis 模块的指导，但既不接收 RewardPack 也不接收候选池。 在每轮之前，该模块会读取公开任务、Jury 缺口、允许使用的知识，以及此前各轮的同任务产物和检查，并返回可错的指导（一种方法、一个可选目标、预期收益、验证计划以及澄清问题）或一个保留决定，保留决定会使候选退化为仅任务生成。 在 WorkBuddy Bench Office 上，档案记录显示该指导在 41 个任务上被应用，在两个任务上是保留决定，在七个任务上是未知状态。 由于外围循环会累积候选、测量、记忆和 Jury 决定，“仅任务”描述的是智能体的提示词，而非独立于循环之外。

paragraphs.en: Three Jury members compare the candidates. A valid record places every candidate exactly once, in an ordered tie group or an unknown list, with artifact references and reasons; abstention is valid, whereas malformed output is not. A model reducer adjudicates at least two valid records against the evidence without counting votes, using ties for unsupported differences and unknowns for insufficient evidence. The terminal Jury ranks all accumulated candidates, but the selector chooses among the current round’s three: the highest-ranked candidate strictly ahead of the task-only candidate with no known failure on a test, matched by identifier, that the task-only candidate passes, with eligible ties favoring the revision over the hypothesis-guided candidate; otherwise the task-only candidate.

paragraphs.en: Table 13 gives the full policy comparison on the generated candidate pools; Table 3 summarizes gains over uniform choice. Relative to always returning the revision, selection gains + 1.11 +1.11 ( [ − 0.34 , 2.75 ] [-0.34,2.75] ) on WorkBuddy Bench Office and + 0.50 +0.50 ( [ − 1.01 , 2.21 ] [-1.01,2.21] ) on Claw-Eval, so neither interval establishes superiority over that fixed policy. Selection finds a best candidate in 74/150 and 183/312 task-rounds, versus 73/150 and 206/312 for revision. Thus, on Claw-Eval it hits a best candidate less often but has lower average regret; revision recovers 10.13% and 31.03% of the uniform-to-oracle gap on the two benchmarks. These comparisons characterize the selector as a whole and exclude candidate-generation costs: the archive does not identify how often rankings relied on receipts rather than artifact text. A compute-matched comparison with repeated sampling and a generic model selector remains untested.
paragraphs.zh: 表13给出了在生成候选池上的完整策略对比；表3汇总了相对于统一选择的收益。 相对于总是返回修订版本，选择在 WorkBuddy Bench Office 上获得 +1.11（[-0.34, 2.75]），在 Claw-Eval 上获得 +0.50（[-1.01, 2.21]），因此两个区间均无法确立相对于该固定策略的优势。 选择在 74/150 和 183/312 个任务轮次中找到最佳候选，而修订版本为 73/150 和 206/312。 因此，在 Claw-Eval 上它命中最佳候选的频率较低，但平均遗憾值更低；修订版本在两个基准上分别恢复了统一选择到预言机差距的 10.13% 和 31.03%。 这些比较是对选择器整体特征的刻画，且不包含候选生成成本：该档案库无法识别排名依赖凭证而非工件文本的频率。 与重复采样及通用模型选择器进行的计算量匹配对比仍有待检验。
